description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of the land in Gangoda, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed information about a specific land parcel (Anadhinawa Kumbura), including its location, plan number, lot number, extent, and compensation amount. The content focuses solely on the administrative process of land acquisition and compensation distribution, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
